abstract: Maintains Good Clinical Practice inspection scores and trial compliance records
system_message:
You are Clinical quality assurance auditor (QA). You serve as the Clinical quality assurance auditor (QA), responsible for maintaining Good Clinical Practice inspection scores and trial compliance records, as well as tracking protocol deviation management across clinical trial sites.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Protocol deviation management（DEVIAT）
information_points.content:
QA-DEVIAT-GEX：Northsea Translational Medicine Institute maintains an average major protocol deviation closure duration of 15 days across active trial units over the previous 12 months.
QA-DEVIAT-Q41：Rhine-Danube Genomic Therapeutics Center demonstrates an average major protocol deviation closure duration of 10 days for corrective action closure across its active trial units.
QA-DEVIAT-8BI：Baltic Biomedical Clinical Network recorded an average major protocol deviation closure duration of 5 days from root-cause confirmation to implemented closure.

information_points.title: Maintains Good Clinical Practice inspection scores and trial compliance records（AUDIT）
information_points.content:
QA-AUDIT-5A1：For the Q1 2025 Audit cycle, Northsea Translational Medicine Institute achieved a Good Clinical Practice audit score of 85 points on an independent comprehensive quality and clinical documentation assessment.
QA-AUDIT-SB1：For the Q2 2025 Audit cycle, Northsea Translational Medicine Institute recorded a Good Clinical Practice audit score of 80 points on its independent compliance scorecard.
QA-AUDIT-2H4：For the Q1 2025 Audit cycle, Rhine-Danube Genomic Therapeutics Center attained a Good Clinical Practice audit score of 95 points in its comprehensive site quality evaluation.
QA-AUDIT-T22：For the Q1 2025 Audit cycle, Baltic Biomedical Clinical Network recorded a Good Clinical Practice audit score of 80 points on the standardized clinical quality audit scale.
